results.name: legacy_confidence_distribution
results.description: Verify that high-confidence legacy links are gated by usable_as_evidence
results.pass_criteria: All legacy links should have usable_as_evidence=0
results.finding: 261934/261934 high-confidence links are gated (usable_as_evidence=0). But 0 are NOT gated.
results.note: All event_links have usable_as_evidence=0 (quarantine applied). However, the orchestrator never checks this column (CF-3).

results.name: orchestrator_gating_column_check
results.description: Verify whether unified_orchestrator_v7.py references quarantine/evidence columns
results.pass_criteria: Orchestrator should check usable_as_evidence, war_period, origin
results.finding: Orchestrator does NOT check usable_as_evidence, war_period, origin, or quarantine columns. No evidence-centric module is imported.

results.name: cross_war_contamination_count
results.description: Count WWII internment links in WWI events database
results.finding: 12759 WWII internment links found in WWI events DB. These are 18 WWI events with WWII contamination.

results.name: record_links_quarantine_status
results.pass_criteria: All legacy links should be quarantined (usable_as_evidence=0)
results.finding: All 169184 record_links have usable_as_evidence=0. 152140 have high confidence but are gated. However, orchestrator does not check this column (Test B).

results.name: collegamenti_legacy_status
results.description: Check if collegamenti table has quarantine columns
results.finding: collegamenti has 2349417 rows but NO quarantine columns (usable_as_evidence, origin, war_period). These legacy entity links are completely unquarantined.

results.name: narrator_status_filtering
results.description: Verify what validation the narrator performs
results.pass_criteria: Narrator should use AnswerEvidenceGate and ClaimStatus
results.finding: Narrator uses NarrationEvidenceSelector + NarrationValidator (weaker validation). AnswerEvidenceGate and ClaimStatus are NOT imported. No verify_answer() call. No AnswerEvidenceBundle construction.

results.name: followup_claim_filtering
results.description: Verify whether execute_followup filters claims by verification status
results.finding: execute_followup passes ALL person_claims and context_claims to AI without status filtering. No AnswerEvidenceGate. No NarrationEvidenceSelector. REJECTED claims included in prompt.

results.name: persistence_stage
results.finding: _stage_persist is a no-op (pass). Snapshots are ephemeral. No evidence trail.

results.name: graph_service_quarantine_check
results.pass_criteria: graph_service should check usable_as_evidence, origin, war_period
results.finding: graph_service checks algorithm_version and legacy_unverified but NOT usable_as_evidence, origin, or war_period. Quarantined links can appear as candidates in the graph.

results.name: v73_barriers_in_orchestrator
results.description: Verify V7.3 temporal/geographic barriers are in the decision path
results.pass_criteria: Orchestrator or narrator should import barriers_v73
results.finding: V7.3 barriers (temporal veto, geographic semantic roles) are NOT imported by orchestrator or narrator. They are only used by narration_planner_v73.py which is not in the main pipeline.

results.name: cross_link_audit_active
results.description: Count active cross-link field changes on internati records
results.pass_criteria: Cross-linked fields should be marked as derived/secondary evidence
results.finding: 40587 active cross-link field changes exist on internati records. These fields were overwritten from external sources (lebi, caduti, decorati) but the orchestrator does not distinguish original vs cross-linked fields.
results.note: Cross-linked fields are not flagged in the evidence pipeline. They appear as original data.

results.name: event_ontology_service_usage
results.pass_criteria: EventOntologyService should be used for event hierarchy validation
results.finding: EventOntologyService is NOT imported by orchestrator or event_resolver. Orchestrator uses v7_event_aggregate (simpler model). Event_resolver uses hardcoded HIERARCHY dict.

results.name: source_lineage_in_fusion
results.description: Verify SourceLineageService integration in fusion stage
results.finding: SourceLineageService is NOT imported by orchestrator or fusion engine. Fusion uses in-memory IndependenceAssessor (heuristic only). DB-backed lineage with authority levels is unused.
